unsupported: The business began as a small cookie and cracker bakery and has been passed down through five generations of the founding family, expanding into a multi-facility operation spanning both the United States and Canada.
Its production lines run at high volume, turning out roughly 8,000 snack bars per minute and more than 150,000 pallets annually, while using about 16 million kilograms of flour each year.
Its customer base includes institutional food-service operators and North American retailers seeking private-label or branded baked goods.
